text:
sam: Heads-up — we need a single-decision thread on flag snapshot + safety cascade for next week's rollout. Key asks: per-tenant snapshot id, gradual weight changes with anti-oscillation, rollback-budget tokens, and A/B pairing.
maya: Good call. Constraints: data residency, Dedicated customers, low-latency SLOs. Require an operator snapshot before any phase >10%.
aj: Implementation idea: snapshot = immutable mapping of flag, variant, weights, model_revision. CLI: `rollout snapshot create --flag ff.routing.v2` -> returns snapshot-id.
lena: Telemetry needs: delta-check on model hallucination rate, conversation continuity (session-loss), token-cost delta. Suggest 3 gating groups: stability, correctness, cost.
sophie: Ops: rollback budget = number of automated rollbacks allowed per 24h per deployment (suggest 3). Also want a grace window for partial rollback (reduce by 50%) before full revert.
devex: SDK behavior: client-side exposure must be deterministic. Propose enum variants and explicit `expose_phase` API; avoid boolean flips that cause thrash.
aj: Anti-oscillation rule: require minimum time between weight changes per slice (30m). No more than 2 manual ops changes in 2h without approval.
sam: For A/B tests: pair randomized cohorts with control+treatment but keep routing pinned for session lifetime. Capture cohort id for long-window evaluation.
harry: Multi-tenant nuance: for geofenced tenants, block region-routing; only allow model-variant downgrades. For enterprise tenants, require manual approval for any >20% traffic increase.
ops-bot: runbook: flag-safety-cascade v1 published at https://internal/runbooks/flag-safety-cascade — oncall notified. :rotating_light:
maya: Draft rollout plan below. Call out gaps and ownership.
```
rollout:
  - prep: snapshot create, smoke tests, tenant-exempt list loaded
  - phase A: pilot tenants (internal + 1 customer) 0.5% traffic, 1h observe
  - phase B: weighted geo-slices NA/EU/APAC 5% each, 1.5h observe, anti-oscillation enforced
  - phase C: latency-bucket cohorts 20% overall, 3h observe
  - phase D: staged global shift 10% increments every 45m, operator approval required >50%
safety_cascade:
  - auto-step1: apply previous variant snapshot if 1 gating group fails for >5m
  - auto-step2: partial weight reduction (50%) if 2 gating groups fail
  - manual-step: escalate to SRE/Ops for region failover (tenant-gated)
telemetry_gates:
  - stability: success_rate drop >0.5pp or p95 latency +20ms
  - correctness: hallucination_rate +0.2pp or regressions on eval prompts
  - cost: per-token cost delta >15%
operators:
  - snapshot CLI: `rollout snapshot create/list/apply`
  - rollback tokens: 3 per 24h per flag
  - operator constraints: min 30m between manual weight changes
```
maya: Gaps I see: audit trail on snapshot application, automated smoke tests in staging, and per-tenant feature opt-outs. Who picks these up?
aj: I'll take automated smoke tests + implement snapshot CLI.
devex: I'll update SDK semantics and naming pattern: `ff.<team>.<feature>.<phase>`, expose `variant` enum.
sophie: Ops will draft runbook appendix for enterprise/geofence flow.
sam: Great. Let's sync tomorrow 10am. :white_check_mark:
